snippet.title: Welcome! Uninvited Guest | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
You were chosen to conduct the ritual to summon the Formless Devourer to consume the evil that will soon come. Unfortunately, you were late to the summoning and now all hell has broken loose. In a last desperate attempt to save humanity, you grab your pack and head to the nearby forest to conduct the ritual for real this time...
